excluded_or_deferred.Portable stations: User explicitly excludes both purchasing and using public stations.
excluded_or_deferred.Repeat consumable boosts: No XP potions, incense, brawlers, proteans, urn purchases, XP capacitors, finite expert amulets or furniture depackers. Herblore training outputs and making urns are not boost-purchase recommendations.
excluded_or_deferred.Minigame training: No Runespan, Great Orb Project, Stealing Creation, Barbarian Assault, Flash Powder Factory, Herby Werby or Gnome Restaurant training loops. Some durable outfit tips name these as their reward source; that does not make them training-method tips.
excluded_or_deferred.Combat training: No vyrelord or other combat-target recommendations. Invention explains gear experience without choosing combat targets.
excluded_or_deferred.Starter cards: No level-1 main methods; first-use baselines still suppress already-unlocked main brackets.
excluded_or_deferred.Very low-value alternatives: Chocolate-cake assembly, dairy churning and similar low-impact tangents are omitted to favour practical methods. There is no claim this is an exhaustive Wiki catalogue.
excluded_or_deferred.Higher diary rewards: Morytania legs 4, Desert amulet 4, Explorer rings, Wilderness swords and Underworld Grimoires were surveyed but are withheld pending a complete prerequisite audit across task tiers and verified handling of alternative requirements. Do not ship a no-requirements diary item simply because native IDs are known. Existing easy Varrock armour gates are reused for Smithing.
excluded_or_deferred.Storage/unlock state: No invented reads for tool belt, house/Diango, relic powers, permanent scroll effects, Fort buildings or blueprint unlock flags. Ownership learns observed item possession permanently. Unlock tips retain normal dismissal/pacing rather than pretending to know unobserved account state.
